standard: NFPA 13 (2019 edition) - Table 23.4.3.1.1, Equivalent Pipe Length Chart
note: DELIBERATELY UNPOPULATED. equivalentLengthFtByNominalSize is empty for every fitting until the published table is supplied; no values are guessed. SprinklerHydraulicCalculator throws CalculationException when a segment references a fitting type/size with no published length, rather than silently treating it as zero. A caller who does not have the table can instead pass an explicit equivalentLengthFt on the segment. Keys are nominalSize values as used in reference/pipes/*.json ("3/4", "1", "1-1/4", ... "8").
cFactorBasisNote: Published lengths are based on C=120. NFPA 13 requires multiplying them by (120/C)^1.85 for pipe with a different C factor (e.g. 0.713 for C=100). That adjustment is NOT applied by the calculator yet - see README.md.
